blocks.orig: The Manta Resort lies on the tropical island of Pemba. Rather than offering five-star luxury, the Manta presents the unique possibility of becoming one with nature. It invites you to switch off all your electronic devices and to become a person with simple needs; sunshine, fresh air, natural food and a comfortable bed. But if you are looking for something special, you can also book the unique underwater room: here you fall asleep surrounded by the underwater world and wake up with all sorts of tropical fish surrounding you to wish you a beautiful new day…!
blocks.html: You find The Manta Resort on Pemba, a tropical island. Instead of five-star luxury, the Manta gives you a unique chance to become one with nature. You are encouraged to turn off all your electronic devices and keep your needs simple: sunshine, fresh air, natural food and a comfortable bed. Looking for something special? Then you can also book the unique underwater room, where you drift off to sleep surrounded by the underwater world and wake up to all kinds of tropical fish around you, wishing you a lovely new day…!
